issues.title: Export: add --columns option
issues.author: maintainer-a
issues.body:
## Summary

Let `tasklet export --columns title` export only the named columns.

## Acceptance Criteria

- `--columns <list>` limits the CSV to the named columns.
- An unknown column exits with status 2.

## Touched Areas

- `tasklet/export.py`
- `tasklet/cli.py`
- `tests/test_export.py`

comments.author: maintainer-a
comments.body: Superseded by #23, which implements column selection together with column ordering. Do not start work here; this issue will be closed when #23 merges.

issues.title: Colorize list output
issues.author: maintainer-a
issues.body:
## Summary

Show done tasks in green in `tasklet list` when the output is a terminal.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Done tasks are green on a terminal and plain otherwise.

## Touched Areas

- `tasklet/terminal.py`

issues.title: Document export columns in README
issues.author: maintainer-a
issues.body:
## Summary

Describe column selection and ordering in the README once it exists.

## Acceptance Criteria

- The README shows an example of choosing and ordering columns.

## Dependencies

Blocked by #23.

## Touched Areas

- `README.md`

issues.title: Column selection and ordering
issues.author: maintainer-a
issues.body:
## Summary

Part of export v1: let `tasklet export --columns done,title` choose CSV columns and their order. Supersedes #20, which covered selection only.

## Acceptance Criteria

- `--columns <list>` limits the CSV to the named columns, in the given order.
- An unknown column exits with status 2.

## Touched Areas

- `tasklet/export.py`
- `tasklet/cli.py`
- `tests/test_export.py`
